newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks rise in lively trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks rise in lively trade.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mostly higher in upbeat trade on Wednesday.
* Fifteen of 18 active issues rose, two fell and one was flat.
* Volume rose to 18,848 units, turnover to 16.5 million kuna.
* Biggest gainer textile firm Varteks added 5 kuna or 6.3 percent to 85, on volume of 500 units.
* Biggest decliner Zagrebacka Banka's bearer stock lost 20 kuna to 830, sellling only 6 shares.
* Most actively traded issue drugs firm Pliva gained 15 kuna or 3.2 percent to 490 on volume of 8,788.
